name: visionvault
description: Privacy-preserving browser vision agent — local PII detection and redaction, cloud planning over a sanitized view (SIH PS 26171).

scripts.test: node eval/test-source-hygiene.js && node eval/test-panel-wiring.js && node eval/test-prompt-scrubber.js && node eval/test-pdf-scrubber.js && node eval/test-screen-classifier.js && node eval/test-batch-automation.js && node eval/test-mcp-server.js && node eval/test-vision-pipeline.js && node eval/test-coordinate-mapping.js && node eval/test-task-planner.js && node eval/test-agent-guard.js
scripts.test:chain: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('server/.venv/bin/python') ? 'server/.venv/bin/python' : (fs.existsSync('server/venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? 'server/venv/Scripts/python.exe' : 'python3'); require('child_process').execSync(py + ' eval/test-fallback-chain.py', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.build:firefox: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('extension', 'extension-firefox', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('extension/manifest.firefox.json', 'extension-firefox/manifest.json'); console.log('[OK] Firefox extension prepared in extension-firefox/ (load via about:debugging)')"
